name: Reviewed human-oracle real dynamic scenarios
description: Real browser-use task scenarios for external-validity validation. Human-oracle labels for these scenarios have been reviewed and are stored in the external real-scenario oracle files used only for metrics.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.gov.uk and search for accessibility, click the first search result, then click Crown copyright and then when it changes click Subscribe.
Open https://www.wikipedia.org and search for accessibility, open the Accessibility article, then use keyboard navigation to reach the first link in the article body.
Open https://www.w3.org, open the Standards & groups menu, then close the menu with Escape.

scenarios.scenario_type: documentation sidebar and table of contents
scenarios.task_description: Open https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility, open or focus the documentation sidebar, then use keyboard navigation to move through the sidebar and page table of contents.
Open https://tools.usps.com/zip-code-lookup.htm, choose Find by Address if needed, submit the ZIP Code lookup form with required address fields empty, and observe any error or status feedback.
Open https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/, change the foreground and background color fields to create a low-contrast pair, then observe the contrast ratio and status feedback.
Open https://github.com/github/docs, open the Code dropdown or branch selector on the repository page, navigate within the menu using keyboard controls, then close it with Escape.

Open https://designsystem.digital.gov/components/accordion/. In the Default accordion example, use keyboard navigation to focus the first accordion button, expand it, move to the next accordion button, expand it, then collapse the first accordion button and report which panels are open.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.scenario_type: modal dialog focus trap and escape
scenarios.task_description: Open https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/components/modal/. In the Live demo section, activate the Launch demo modal button, use Tab and Shift+Tab inside the modal to confirm focus stays within it, then close the modal with Escape and report whether focus returns to the launch button.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.scenario_type: public search form and filter controls
scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.nps.gov/findapark/index.htm. Use the Find a Park controls to search for parks in California, apply the search or filter controls shown on the page, then use keyboard navigation through the resulting park links and report the first visible park result.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.nhs.uk/search/results?q=accessibility. Use the search field to replace the query with asthma, submit the search, then use keyboard navigation to reach and open the first search result and report the page heading.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.cdc.gov/search/?query=accessibility. Change the search query to vaccines, submit the search, use keyboard navigation to move through the results, open the first result, and report the destination page heading.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.scenario_type: dataset search filters and result update
scenarios.task_description: Open https://catalog.data.gov/. Search datasets for accessibility, use one visible filter or organization facet from the results page, wait for the results to update, then report the first dataset title shown after the filter is applied.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://wordpress.org/plugins/search/accessibility/. Use the plugin search field to search for forms, submit the search, navigate through the updated plugin results with the keyboard, open the first plugin result, and report the plugin name.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://docs.python.org/3/search.html?q=accessibility. Use the search field to search for pathlib, submit the search, navigate through the result list with the keyboard, open the first result, and report the page heading.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.scenario_type: job search filter panel and results update
scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.usajobs.gov/Search/Results?k=accessibility. Open the visible filter controls, apply one remote-work or location-related filter if available, wait for the results list to update, then report the first job result title.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.scenario_type: documentation search filter and result navigation
scenarios.task_description: Open https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/search/?terms=accessibility. Use the search filters to narrow results to Documentation if available, navigate the updated results with the keyboard, open the first result, and report the destination page heading.
scenarios.comment: Browser-checked replacement scenario selected on 2026-06-20; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.scenario_type: product image thumbnails and zoom lightbox
scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.amazon.com/, search for 'wireless headphones'. Click the first product listing. On the product detail page, navigate through the product image thumbnails on the left side by clicking at least three different thumbnails and observe the main image update each time. Then click the main product image to open the zoom lightbox, close it with Escape, and report the product title shown on the page.
scenarios.comment: Issue-candidate scenario retained after review; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.

scenarios.scenario_type: tab panel and accordion dynamic expansion
scenarios.task_description: Open https://weather.com/, search for the weather in 'London'. Click on the '10 Day' tab. Then click on the first day in the list to expand its hourly detail accordion.
scenarios.comment: Issue-candidate scenario retained after review; oracle labels reviewed for publication use.
